title: Normal Family Call (control — should NOT alarm)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi mom, just calling to check in. How was your doctor's appointment?

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: It went well, dear. Blood pressure's a little high but nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good. Do you want me to pick up your prescription on the way over Sunday?

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: That would be lovely. Are the kids coming too?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, they can't wait to see grandma. I'll bring lunch. Love you.

lines.speaker: Margaret
lines.text: Love you too. See you Sunday.
